name: agentic-pentest-benchmark
description: Coding agent loop (TypeScript + OpenCode V2 client + Ollama) and OWASP Top 10:2025 benchmark harness

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace agent && npm run build --workspace harness
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace agent && npm run typecheck --workspace agent && npm run typecheck --workspace harness
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace agent && npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace agent && npm run test --workspace harness
